title: Lesson 2 — Vocabulary Exhibition
notes: Intro: 3s black → 2s artwork fade-in (gallery style); no opening crest. Outro: gold gallery crest hold, fades with soundtrack end. Rebuild each verse from vocabulary and phrases; same gallery atmosphere. ~19 steps per exhibit. Soundtrack 1:12:25; crest exhale syncs to bed end.

霧きりの谷たにだけが　光ひかりを留とめていた
